item: tools/workflow_gate.py's receipt check (G6) currently greps for a 'watch/inbox' string but accepts any content: the guard set is empty. Extend G6 minimally: a receipt-path mention must ALSO carry a dated-stamp pattern within the script (same YYYY-MM-DD regex family as githooks/pre-push freshness block, t62), still WARN-shaped inside the gate report (a missing date is a check finding listed in output, not a new hard-block exit: the gate's exit contract 0/1/2 stays untouched; fold the finding into the G6 row's ok flag as a soft-false with reason). Spec comment first. Update or add tests (tests/test_workflow_gate.py if exists: script with dated receipt passes G6 ok=true; script with undated receipt fails G6 or flags per the contract you implement; cite exactly which). Run pytest + cite; tools/violation_ratchet.py check --changed + cite. Save evidence to LANES/t69.check.txt.
note: G6 extended in tools/workflow_gate.py: the CHECKS entry lambda is unchanged (receipt-path mention = hard gate, absent mention still FAIL exit 2) and a module-level G6_STAMP_RE now requires a dated stamp in the same regex family as the t62 githooks/pre-push freshness prefilter, case-insensitive like freshness_gate.STAMP_RE: (?i)\b(source[-_ ]fetched|fetched|observed[-_]at)\s*:\s*\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}. The main loop folds a missing stamp into the G6 row as a soft-false: row ok=false plus soft=true plus reason, kept out of the failed set, so verdict stays PASS, exit stays 0, and the 0/1/2 exit contract is untouched; the row prints as a WARN line and the registry row carries soft/reason. Spec landed first (one SPEC t69 comment line above the G6 entry plus the module docstring G6 line), behavior second. Tests: tests/test_workflow_gate.py did not exist, so it was ADDED (4 tests, subprocess through the real CLI, cwd=tmp so test rows never touch the real REGISTRY.jsonl): dated receipt passes G6 ok=true exit 0; undated receipt (the t51 'fetched: all present' prose shape) gives G6 ok=false soft=true with reason, verdict PASS exit 0; missing receipt mention is the original hard FAIL exit 2; G6_STAMP_RE family pinned directly including the t51 false positive staying unmatched. Two fixture bugs were hit and fixed en route (template literals do not satisfy G2, needs JSON.stringify(x) or + x.text; the first missing-receipt fixture still mentioned watch/inbox in a base comment), both visible in the ledger as debug rows. Negatives on record: (1) one manual debug row (name t69dbg, digest cfcc50823fe1, verdict FAIL) appended to the REAL memory/workflows/REGISTRY.jsonl because the gate's REGISTRY path is cwd-relative and the first manual run used cwd=repo root; filed in t69.check.txt section D, not hidden, cleanup left to operator since the registry is an append-only ledger by design. (2) The ratchet's own PASS line in section C contains an em-dash as raw tool output; it is saved raw per the raw-output law and is not authored text. (3) G6 checks script text only, not the receipt file itself, matching the gate's grep-style contract; a receipt path that lies about a filed file is out of scope for G6.
